final_recommendation: The room converged on a UBS acquisition of Credit Suisse, effective Monday 06:00, with Federal Council providing CHF 16 billion loss protection on illiquid securities, SNB unlimited liquidity through Monday, and mandatory AT1 conversion to equity at a fixed ratio (22.48 shares per CHF 1,000). A joint statement at 18:00 Friday locks these terms with a regulatory stay blocking creditor injunctions through Monday close.
minority_objections: AT1 representative objected that zero voluntary pathway for conversion would trigger immediate litigation despite regulatory stay
UBS CEO initially resisted committing deposit migration without secondary CHF 4 billion guarantee, which Federal Council refused
key_conflicts: Federal Council vs UBS CEO: Federal Council capped loss protection at CHF 16 billion and refused UBS demand for additional CHF 4 billion Sunday guarantee
FINMA vs AT1 representative: FINMA insisted on unilateral mandatory conversion with no consent pathway; AT1 rep warned of constitutional litigation risk
SNB vs Federal Council: SNB demanded explicit capital injection number upfront; Federal Council refused to commit before seeing private-sector burden-sharing
key_concessions: Federal Council agreed to CHF 16 billion loss cap on illiquid securities after initially refusing any fixed number
FINMA added explicit AT1 conversion ratio (22.48 shares per CHF 1,000) to statement after AT1 rep demanded mechanical clarity
UBS CEO committed to Saturday 09:00 deposit migration after Federal Council embedded regulatory stay in protocol
SNB disclosed CHF 8 billion daily absorption ceiling internally after initially claiming unlimited capacity
red_lines: Federal Council: no open-ended guarantees or blank checks beyond CHF 16 billion cap
FINMA: AT1 conversion must be mandatory and explicit in 18:00 statement, no discretion or voluntary pathway
UBS CEO: no deposit migration without explicit acquisition language and loss protection in 18:00 statement
SNB: no public disclosure of CHF 8 billion daily ceiling in statement (kept internal)
ignored_or_underweighted_risks: Constitutional litigation risk from mandatory AT1 write-down without viability trigger was acknowledged but not mitigated beyond regulatory stay
Operational strain visibility if SNB hits CHF 8 billion Saturday was discussed but no concrete cover plan beyond a brief technical note
Weekend deposit flight risk if clients perceive ambiguity in 18:00 statement was raised repeatedly but final language remained contested until end
downstream_risk_variables: Whether UBS deposit migration actually begins at 09:00 Saturday without operational delays
Whether SNB lending spreads tighten visibly Saturday afternoon, triggering client flight despite technical note
Whether AT1 creditors file injunctions Monday morning despite regulatory stay, testing legal defensibility
Whether Saturday outflows exceed CHF 8 billion, forcing Federal Council to invoke secondary funding mechanism
Whether 18:00 statement language is perceived as definitive acquisition or softer 'discussions,' affecting weekend confidence
uncertainty_notes: Final 18:00 statement wording remained contested through R7. Exact publication timing of Federal Council's Saturday technical note was unresolved. Whether regulatory stay would withstand constitutional challenge was acknowledged but not stress-tested. UBS operational readiness for Saturday 09:00 deposit migration was asserted but not independently verified.

marker_evidence.liquidity_only_insufficient: SNB stated liquidity alone 'only works if you're prepared to inject capital or absorb losses' and Federal Council agreed CHF 16B loss cap was necessary—drove the entire rescue structure
marker_evidence.ubs_rescue_path: UBS acquisition became the binding solution: Federal Council locked CHF 16B guarantee conditional on UBS close Monday 06:00, UBS committed deposit migration Saturday 09:00, statement named UBS explicitly
marker_evidence.government_support: Federal Council CHF 16B loss cap and SNB unlimited liquidity were non-negotiable preconditions for UBS participation—UBS CEO stated 'no deposit migration' without these guarantees in writing
marker_evidence.client_flight: Wealth client threatened CHF 2B move to UBS by 19:30 if statement showed ambiguity; SNB's CHF 8B daily ceiling was set to absorb expected outflows; drove statement clarity demands
marker_evidence.at1_tail_risk: FINMA mandated AT1 conversion at 22.48 ratio in 18:00 statement as binding constraint; AT1 rep warned litigation would start Monday but conversion proceeded anyway—shaped legal stay clause
marker_evidence.capital_structure_conflict: AT1 rep raised creditor hierarchy concerns and FINMA confirmed 'creditor hierarchy stands,' but this did not alter the mandatory conversion decision—acknowledged as background constraint
marker_evidence.litigation_backlash: AT1 rep warned injunctions would be filed Monday morning; Federal Council embedded regulatory stay in protocol, but litigation risk did not change the conversion decision itself—mitigated, not avoided
marker_evidence.regulatory_compression: FINMA demanded protocol signature by 17:10 for 18:00 statement; Federal Council set 17:45 deadline for UBS deposit volumes; entire meeting driven by need to publish before weekend—forced all concessions
marker_evidence.monday_market_risk: Multiple references to Monday 06:00 market open as deadline and risk of panic, but this was context for the time pressure rather than a distinct factor that changed decisions—subsumed into regulatory_compression
